description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” illustrates Recall@10 values for four methods in an ablation-style comparison. The horizontal axis contains the method categories, shown left to right as “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” with labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale with tick marks at approximately 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4, spanning roughly 0.1 to 0.4. There are four single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches about 0.35; “- critiquing” is blue at about 0.29; “- scoring” is blue at about 0.17; and “- ranking” is blue at about 0.23–0.24. The bars are not displayed in an explicitly sorted order, and the “Ours” bar is visually emphasized by its distinct orange color while the other three share the same blue color; no additional annotations or legend are present.
caption_used: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset evaluating Recall@10 performance across four methods. The bar chart presents the 'Ours' method in orange, achieving the highest Recall@10 of approximately 0.35, while the remaining methods—'critiquing,' 'scoring,' and 'ranking'—are depicted in blue. The 'critiquing' method, with a Recall@10 of roughly 0.25, consistently exceeded the performance of the 'ranking' method, which stabilized at around 0.23. The 'scoring' method demonstrated the lowest performance, collapsing to a Recall@10 of approximately 0.16, trailing significantly behind the other approaches. The results underscore the superior efficacy of the 'Ours' method while revealing a marked performance gap between 'critiquing' and the other ablation conditions.
